title: Find your local council in NSW
summary: Find information and contact details for local councils and local government areas in NSW.
intro: The NSW Government agency responsible for strengthening the local government sector and regulating local councils is the Office of Local Government (OLG).
contact:
To browse or download local council contact details go to the Office of Local Government Local Government Directory.

The directory holds website addresses and phone numbers for:

external_links.text: make a complaint about a council

faqs.q: Who regulates local councils in NSW?
faqs.a: The Office of Local Government (OLG) is the NSW Government agency responsible for strengthening the local government sector and regulating local councils.

faqs.q: How can I find my local council or check which LGA a suburb is in?
faqs.a: You can use the online search tool to find your local council or check which local government area (LGA) a suburb is in.

faqs.q: Where can I find contact details for local councils?
faqs.a: You can browse or download local council contact details from the Office of Local Government Local Government Directory.

faqs.q: What should I do if I have a complaint about a local council?
faqs.a: You can find out who to contact first, how the Office of Local Government can assist, and learn about the complaints handling process.
